releaseSummary: Phase 2.5 expands the static PWA into a fully branded Digital Dhamma Library installation surface. The release adds a complete project-specific manifest, optimized SVG logos/icons/screenshots/banner/poster assets, PWA shortcuts, audio file handling, custom protocol handlers, and a service-worker-backed share target suitable for static GitHub Pages hosting. The Phase 2.4.5 manifest migration/build protections and Phase 2.4.3 TypeScript/typegen fix remain intact.
